        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + (t + v))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S v -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (t + v) +
      (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (t + v) -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + (t + v)))

  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑(b r) + (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t + ↑(b t)) -
      (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) + ↑(b (r + t))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t -
            RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) +
          ↑(b r) +
        ↑(b t) -
      ↑(b (r + t))

type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), ⟨RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal W W 1, ⋯⟩ = 1

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonalRing._proof_4

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonalRing._proof_5
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (f g : AddMonoid.End ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonalRing._proof_6

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonalRing._proof_7
type:

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonalRing._proof_8
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x x_1 : AddMonoid.End ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonalRing._proof_9
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x x_1 : AddMonoid.End ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  ⟨RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal W W (x + x_1), ⋯⟩ = ⟨RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal W W (x + x_1), ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal_admissible
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V)),

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal_injective
type: ∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Function.Injective (RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal U V)

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal_restriction
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (c : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient)

  RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal U V (RealizationBoundaries.diagonalRestriction U V c h) = c

name: RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal_unique
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V)) (c : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_coordinate_formula
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U)) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_eq_diagonal
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U)),

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_image_finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_image_torsion
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
      (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • f x = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_injective_iff_diagonal_nonzero
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V)),

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_preserves_zero_coordinate
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U)) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑x p = 0 → ↑(f x) p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_surjective_diagonal_nonzero
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V)),
  Function.Surjective ⇑f → ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.homDiagonal U V f p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_zero_of_divisible
type:
∀ (E : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup E],
  (∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m → ∀ (x : E), ∃ y, m • y = x) → ∀ (f : E →+ RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), f = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator
type: Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime → RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator.eq_1

∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator_apply_mem

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator_apply_not_mem
type:

  p ∉ S → RealizationBoundaries.indicator S p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator_tail_ne_zero
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite → RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.instIsAddTorsionFreeTailSpace
type: IsAddTorsionFree RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerMultiplication
type:
(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  ℕ → ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerMultiplication._proof_1
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ), m • 0 = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerMultiplication._proof_2
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  m • (x + y) = m • x + m • y

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv
type:
(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  {m : ℕ} →
    0 < m →
      ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m ≃+
        RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv._proof_1
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ}, (RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m).Normal

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv._proof_2
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ}, (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m).ker.Normal

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv._proof_3
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m = (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m).ker

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv.congr_simp
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m),
  RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv W hm = RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv W hm

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv_mk
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv W hm) ↑x = (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) x

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv_restriction
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hmn : m ∣ n)
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W n),
  (RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv W hm) ((RealizationBoundaries.quotientRestriction W hmn) x) =
    (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateRestriction hmn) ((RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv W hn) x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotient_card
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    Nat.card (↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m) =
      RealizationBoundaries.primeRadical m

name: RealizationBoundaries.intermediate_dense
type: ∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H → Dense ↑H

name: RealizationBoundaries.inverseDiagonal
type: RealizationBoundaries.Ambient → RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.inverseDiagonal_admissible
type:
∀ (S T : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  S.Infinite →
    ∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      RealizationBoundaries.DiagonalAdmissible (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S)
          (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T) c →

          RealizationBoundaries.DiagonalAdmissible (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine T)
            (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine S) (RealizationBoundaries.inverseDiagonal c)

name: RealizationBoundaries.inverseDiagonal_apply
type:
∀ (c : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  RealizationBoundaries.inverseDiagonal c p = (c p)⁻¹

name: RealizationBoundaries.markedElement
type: (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) → ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.markedElement._proof_1
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.indicator S ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S

name: RealizationBoundaries.markedElement_not_finiteSupport
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},

name: RealizationBoundaries.marked_prime_root_iff
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_coordinateKernel
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥H),

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_coordinateKernel._simp_1
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥H),
  (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.coordinateKernel H p) = (↑x p = 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_finiteSupport
type:
∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ↔ (RealizationBoundaries.support x).Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_finiteSupport._simp_1
type:
∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport) = (RealizationBoundaries.support x).Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_multiples
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m ↔ ∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_multiples._simp_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m) = ∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_preimage
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W ↔ RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x ∈ W

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_preimage._simp_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) = (RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x ∈ W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_quotient_image_iff
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H →
    ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H ↔ x ∈ H

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_rationalImage
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (hD : RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H)
  (hH : RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H) (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  v ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage H hD hH ↔ v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_rationalImage._simp_1
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (hD : RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H)
  (hH : RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H) (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  (v ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage H hD hH) = (v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_rootKernel
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m ↔ m • y = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_rootKernel._simp_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rootKernel W m) = (m • y = 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_selectorGroup_iff
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S ↔
    ∃ r, r • RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) = RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_support
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.support x ↔ x p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_support._simp_1
type:
∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  (p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.support x) = (x p ≠ 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples
type: (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) → ℕ → AddSubgroup ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_antitone
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m n : ℕ},
  m ∣ n → RealizationBoundaries.multiples W n ≤ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_eq_of_same_prime_divisors
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m n : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    0 < n →
      (∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m ↔ ↑p ∣ n) →
        RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m = RealizationBoundaries.multiples W n

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_eq_radical
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m = RealizationBoundaries.multiples W (RealizationBoundaries.primeRadical m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_open
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → IsOpen ↑(RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_completion_invariant_reconstruction
type:
∀ (R : (ℕ → Bool) → Type u_1) [inst : (a : ℕ → Bool) → AddGroup (R a)],
  (∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
      Nonempty
          (↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion
                    (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a))).toProfinite.toTop ≃ₜ+
            ↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion
                    (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b))).toProfinite.toTop) →
        Nonempty (R a ≃+ R b)) →
    (∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), Nonempty (R a ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a))) → False

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_injective_hom_of_infinite_disagreement
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)), ¬Function.Injective ⇑f

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_lift_of_commonCompletionEquiv
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ¬∃ f,
        ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)),
          (RealizationBoundaries.pairedCommonCompletionEquiv a b)
              (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)) x) =
            ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)) (f x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_section
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (w : ↥W),

    ∀ (s : ↥W →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
      (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).comp s ≠ AddMonoidHom.id ↥W

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_section_of_nontrivial
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) [Nontrivial ↥W],
  ¬∃ s, (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).comp s = AddMonoidHom.id ↥W

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_surjective_hom_of_infinite_disagreement
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)), ¬Function.Surjective ⇑f

name: RealizationBoundaries.nontorsion_source_of_image
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U)),
  ↑(f x) ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → ↑x ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.nonzero_coordinate
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), x ≠ 0 → ∃ p, ↑x p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd
type:
Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime →
  ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport →
    ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd.eq_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y = (x.1 + y.1, x.2 + y.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 y.1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) z =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y z)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc._abel_1_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  x.2 + y.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 y.1 + z.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (x.1 + y.1) z.1 =
    x.2 + y.2 + z.2 + (RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 y.1 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (x.1 + y.1) z.1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc._abel_1_2
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  x.2 + y.2 + z.2 + (RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S y.1 z.1 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 (y.1 + z.1)) =
    x.2 + (y.2 + z.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S y.1 z.1) + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 (y.1 + z.1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_comm
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y = RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_inverse
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (-x.1, -x.2) = (0, 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_zero
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (0, 0) = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate
type:
(S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) →
  ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate._proof_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.1 + ↑x.2 ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_add
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S x + RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S y

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_add._abel_1_2
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (x.1 + y.1) +
      (↑x.2 + ↑y.2 +
        (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.1 + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S y.1 -
          RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (x.1 + y.1))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.1 + ↑x.2 + (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S y.1 + ↑y.2)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_bijective
type: ∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime}, S.Infinite → Function.Bijective (RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormEquiv
type:
{S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} →
  S.Infinite → ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≃ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport
type:
(a b : ℕ → Bool) →
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite →
    RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) →
      RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport.congr_simp
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite)
  (x x_1 : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)),
  x = x_1 → RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport a b h x = RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport a b h x_1

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransportEquiv
type:

name: RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit.eq_1
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (k n : ℕ), RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit a k n = if n = k then !a n else a n

name: RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit_disagreement
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ), {n | a n ≠ RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit a k n} = {k}

name: RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit_group_eq
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a = RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup (RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit a k)

name: RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit_ne
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ), a ≠ RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit a k

name: RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit_not_marked_isomorphic
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  ¬∃ e,
      e (RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)) =
        RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector (RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit a k))

RealizationBoundaries.topologicalEndomorphismHull_univ

name: RealizationBoundaries.topological_generator_transport
RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor
type:
(a b : ℕ → Bool) →
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    (↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)) →
      ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_1
type: AddSubmonoidClass (AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_2
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)),
      ↑(f 0) ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_3
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)), ⟨↑(f 0), ⋯⟩ = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_4
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
      (x y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ↑(f (x + y)) ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor._proof_5
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
  (x y : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ⟨↑(f (x + y)), ⋯⟩ = ⟨↑(f x), ⋯⟩ + ⟨↑(f y), ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor_commutes
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport.subtype.comp (RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor a b h f) =
    (RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b).subtype.comp f

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor_unique
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
  (g : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport.subtype.comp g = (RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b).subtype.comp f →
    g = RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor a b h f

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor_val
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ↑((RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor a b h f) x) = ↑(f x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsion_iff_finiteSupport
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), (∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • x = 0) ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.unique_root_iff_one
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), (∃ y, m • y = x) → ((∃! y, m • y = x) ↔ m = 1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiberEquiv
type:
(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W 0 0 ≃ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiberEquiv._proof_1
type: AddSubmonoidClass (AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiberEquiv._proof_2
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), 0 • x = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiberEquiv._proof_3
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W 0 0), 0 • ↑x = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiberEquiv._proof_4
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W 0 0), ⟨↑x, ⋯⟩ = ⟨↑x, ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiberEquiv._proof_5
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), ↑⟨x, ⋯⟩ = ↑⟨x, ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiber_card
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Nat.card (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W 0 0) = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiber_infinite
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Infinite (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W 0 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiber_isEmpty_of_ne_zero
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  x ≠ 0 → IsEmpty (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W 0 x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.zeroRootFiber_nonempty
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Nonempty (RealizationBoundaries.RootFiber W 0 0)
